## c4201 数値の再計算（転記値）
- 職業訓練 表1・表2 の有職率・一致率 28、男＋女＝全体 3、検証1 の χ²（率から人数を逆算、p≒0.0002）。SIB のプロセス指標・アウトカム指標の割合 10、対照群 33/379＝8.7％。計 43 項目、NG 0。
- SIB の支援対象者 29人では、四捨五入で 5％ になる人数がない（1人 3.4％、2人 6.9％）。1人/20 対 33/379 の両側 p＝1.0、1人/29 では 0.49。
523da6b707c33d1e829b3e58bc74883f75df52e9.en:
## c4201 Recalculation of figures (transcribed values)
- Vocational training Tables 1 and 2: employment rates and agreement rates 28; male + female = overall 3; χ² for Analysis 1 (counts back-calculated from the rates, p≈0.0002). SIB process indicator and outcome indicator percentages 10; control group 33/379 = 8.7%. Total 43 items, NG 0.
- With 29 SIB support recipients, there is no number of persons that rounds to 5% (1 person 3.4%, 2 persons 6.9%). Two-sided p for 1/20 vs 33/379 = 1.0; for 1/29, 0.49.

3fe2d8824e6121b7d2463a74947f500aea545481.ja:
## 職業訓練
- 本文「職業訓練の効果検証上の課題」：編入は希望者のみから選定、生活態度良好、健康状態に問題なし、などの条件 → バイアスの統制が必要。
- 統制した変数：出所時年齢・入所回数・出所時の制限区分・能力検査値（傾向スコアマッチング、各 2,218名）。
- 結果：保護観察終了時の有職率 78.7％・74.0％。本文は「安定した就労を継続している者の割合が高い」、結論は「出所後の安定的な就労に寄与」。→ 記録 SK-C1。
- 検証2 の一致率は対象者全体（2,575）が分母（17.5％）。結論の「有職である修了者のうち少なくとも約2割」は 450/1,990＝22.6％ に当たり、矛盾しない。
3fe2d8824e6121b7d2463a74947f500aea545481.en:
## Vocational training
- Main text, "Issues in evaluating the effectiveness of vocational training": participants are selected only from those who applied, under conditions such as good conduct and no health problems → bias needs to be controlled.
- Variables controlled: age at release, number of admissions, restriction category at release, aptitude test score (propensity score matching, 2,218 persons in each group).
- Results: employment rate at the end of probation 78.7% and 74.0%. The main text states "the proportion of those continuing in stable employment is higher", and the conclusion is "contributes to stable employment after release". → record SK-C1.
- The agreement rate in Analysis 2 uses all subjects (2,575) as the denominator (17.5%). The conclusion's "at least about 20% of completers who are employed" corresponds to 450/1,990 = 22.6%, and the two do not contradict each other.

6bdd7563a317656da52e28df8c19f19dcdfd326a.ja:
## 刑務作業
- 釈放時アンケートの受け止め→就労イメージ→保護観察終了時の有職→2年以内再入の関連（各段で χ² 検定）。刑務作業の有無や量による比較はない。本文はロジックモデルとして示し、妥当性の検証が必要と書く。記録にしない。
6bdd7563a317656da52e28df8c19f19dcdfd326a.en:
## Prison work
- Associations along the chain: how prison work was perceived in the release questionnaire → image of employment → employment at the end of probation → re-admission within 2 years (χ² test at each stage). There is no comparison by whether prison work was done or by its amount. The main text presents this as a logic model and states that its validity needs to be verified. Not made a record.

b7276e228bdd5d11cfa5cc4ea5a963b4fc844dae.ja:
## SIB（非行少年への学習支援）
- 支援対象者 29人（想定 80人）。再処分率：支援対象者 5％、対照群（2021・22年に全国の少年院を出院した進学・復学希望者 379人）8.7％、指数「57」、評価A・支払 100％。分母は書かれていない。
- 本文：29人は統計分析には過少。概要：対照群と比べて「因果関係の評価が行われた」。→ 記録 SB-C1。
b7276e228bdd5d11cfa5cc4ea5a963b4fc844dae.en:
## SIB (learning support for juvenile delinquents)
- Support recipients: 29 persons (80 planned). Re-disposition rate: support recipients 5%, control group (379 persons wishing to go on to or return to school who left juvenile training schools nationwide in 2021 and 2022) 8.7%, index "57", rating A, payment 100%. The denominator is not stated.
- Main text: 29 persons is too few for statistical analysis. Summary: compared with the control group, "an evaluation of the causal relationship was conducted". → record SB-C1.
